图片内文字：
- Follow up actions from previous PEC (Mar. 2026)

表格（表头：Topic | Action | Owner | Due Day | Update | Completion (Y/N)）
- Topic：Sample size commitment to CDE  
  - Action：  
    - To review the previous sample size commitments and assess any potential risks.  
    - To evaluate the pre-IND package review process and update as needed.  
  - Owner：  
    - TA and RA  
    - PPM to lead  
  - Due Day：Apr PEC  
  - Update：  
    - RA TAHs reviewed the previous TA pre-IND packages for any disclosure of unnecessary sample size allocation breakdown (Mainland/TW/HK). No additional cases identified. The current case was a single case, and review process was followed.  
    - Process strengthened: Add a note in the process document “China Sample Size Proposal for Joining Pivotal Studies (Registration Purpose)”: “Do not share unnecessary allocation details (esp. Mainland/TW/HK), which is internal execution-level alignment; default to Greater China total sample size for HA communication.”  
  - Completion (Y/N)：Y
- Topic：Communication on CFDI/CDE comments/questions  
  - Action：To report comments/questions from CFDI/CDE immediately once received and share the responses with related MLT.  
  - Owner：RA  
  - Due Day：Apr PEC  
  - Update：RA function has embedded the agreed process into daily practice to immediately inform CFDI/CDE formal questions and circulate responses to the relevant MLT.  
  - Completion (Y/N)：Y

- Boehringer Ingelheim
- 2

视觉关系：
- 页面为表格结构：按行列对应关系呈现“Topic-Action-Owner-Due Day-Update-Completion (Y/N)”的逐项跟进行动。
- 两条事项（两行）在“Due Day”均为“Apr PEC”，且“Completion (Y/N)”均为“Y”，表示两项在同一截止节点完成。
